## Access to the learning materials

OroujiLab Learning is free to read and use for personal learning. The source files are publicly viewable at [OroujiLab/learn](https://github.com/OroujiLab/learn). Public access to source code does **not** by itself grant permission to reproduce or redistribute it under an open-source license.

The rights holder has **not yet issued a general software or educational-content reuse license** for this edition. Until explicit licenses are supplied, please request permission before republishing or modifying substantial portions of the original materials.

| Materials | Current status |
|---|---|
| Original lesson text, authored handouts, figures and synthetic exercises | Free to view; no blanket redistribution license has yet been issued |
| Website code, interactive JavaScript and reusable CSS | Publicly viewable; software reuse license not yet issued |
| Epigenome Lab emblem | Separately reserved; no implied license to use the lab identity |
| Published papers, third-party software, fonts and external datasets | Governed by their own licenses and copyright notices |

## How to cite a lesson

Cite the lesson title, *OroujiLab Learning*, the specific page URL and access date. Where a research method, result or figure concept originates in the scientific literature, cite its **original primary publication** as well.

All diagrams created for these lessons are original educational illustrations. Synthetic examples are not measurements from patients or published benchmark results.

## Corrections and reuse requests

For a scientific correction, reproducibility issue or reuse-permission question, use the [public repository's Issues page](https://github.com/OroujiLab/learn/issues) and identify the relevant lesson or asset.
